nodes.label: Anonymous Telemetry (self-hosted daily ping)
nodes.rationale: Exists because self-hosted installations cannot be counted otherwise (Docker Hub pulls do not equal live installations); answers only three questions: does the installation exist, which version, is it used. Opt-out by default with explicit precedence (TELEMETRY_ENABLED > TELEMETRY_DISABLED > DO_NOT_TRACK > NODE_ENV != prod > on); 60s startup delay avoids counting CI/smoke tests; 5s timeout, never retried, failures swallowed so telemetry can never break the orchestrator; only outbound, no endpoint accepts pings and nothing is fetched back (no feature flags, no license checks); payload changes only in public via TelemetryDTO.ts, docs, startup log and CHANGELOG in the same release

nodes.label: Telemetry Payload (aggregate counters only)
nodes.rationale: Exactly eight fields: installationId, version, nodeVersion, projects, microfrontends, environments, users, deploymentsLastWeek. Counts only, never names, emails, URLs, hostnames, IPs, secrets or content; the code has no way to send anything else

nodes.label: Telemetry Installation ID
nodes.rationale: Random crypto.randomUUID() generated on first ping and stored in the user's own database (configurations collection, TELEMETRY_INSTALLATION_ID); derived from nothing about the host, deletable at will; exists only to avoid counting one installation as thousands
